### Project Name

hippo-memory

### Project Description

hippo-memory is an open-source (MIT), local-first memory layer for AI coding agents and any MCP client.

It writes what a developer teaches one coding agent into a single SQLite store with readable, git-committable markdown mirrors in `.hippo/`, so Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Pi, OpenClaw, Gemini CLI, Kiro, and any MCP client read and share the same memory. Switching agents no longer means starting over.

Unlike cloud-hosted memory services that wrap every write in an extra LLM call, hippo-memory makes zero LLM calls on its default save and recall path, has zero required runtime dependencies (built on Node.js 22.16+ built-in `node:sqlite`), and installs a local Transformers.js embedder (`@huggingface/transformers`) during `hippo init`.

Key capabilities:
- **Biologically inspired memory lifecycle:** Provenance envelope (`MEMORY_ENVELOPE.md`), outcome feedback (`hippo outcome --bad` weakens memories behind poor answers), fact supersession (`hippo supersede`), decay for unused items with pinned rules that never fade, and sleep consolidation (`hippo sleep`).
- **Git-native transparency:** Every memory has a readable markdown mirror in `.hippo/` that teams can diff, grep, and review in pull requests, plus `hippo learn --git` to learn from commit history and `hippo dashboard` for local memory health inspection.
- **Self-hosted team server:** `hippo serve` shares one store across a team over MCP and HTTP with per-user API keys, roles, an audit log, and Slack and GitHub connectors.
- **Pre-registered outcome results:** In a pre-registered evaluation on real Claude Code sessions across 29 repositories (`docs/evals/2026-11-08-z0-round3-result.md`), installing hippo cut repeat mistakes from 21 in 100 (built-in memory) and 83 in 100 (no memory) down to 11 in 100, at the same token cost (1.006x). On public memory benchmarks: PersonaMem v1 72.4% (vs MemOS 61.2% published), LongMemEval-S 88.5%, LoCoMo 89.4%, DMR 77.6%, HaluMem-Long 65.99% (1st of 6), and IMLogic 38.33% (4th of 9).

**Origin and history:** Created in March 2026 by Kit Fun (Keith) So (KITFUNSO LTD, London) to give developers portable, inspectable agent memory owned on their own machines. The project has shipped 223 releases to date (current: `v3.15.1` on npm and `0.3.4` for `hippo-memory-sdk` on PyPI).

### Preferred Lifecycle Stage (if known)

Sandbox

### Alignment with AAIF Mission

hippo-memory directly supports the Agentic AI Foundation's mission to build neutral, open, interoperable infrastructure for agentic AI:

- **Vendor-neutral portability:** Keeps agent memory out of proprietary editor silos in open local SQLite + markdown files readable across every major coding harness.
- **Open standards and explicit contracts:** Publishes `MEMORY_ENVELOPE.md` (typed provenance fields: `kind`, `scope`, `owner`, `artifact_ref`, `session_id`, `confidence`, `created`, with append-only raw records and auditable archiving) and ships a native MCP server (`io.github.kitfunso/hippo-memory`).
- **Transparent, reproducible evaluation:** Every benchmark and live-session study is pre-registered and published openly in `docs/evals/` and `benchmarks/`, advancing shared reliability standards for agentic systems.

### Relation to Existing AAIF Projects

- **Model Context Protocol (MCP):** hippo-memory exposes 13 memory tools over MCP (`hippo mcp`) and is published in the Official MCP Registry (`io.github.kitfunso/hippo-memory`).
- **AGENTS.md:** Complements static `AGENTS.md` project instructions with dynamic, session-captured rules, lessons, and project memories stored locally with readable markdown mirrors alongside `AGENTS.md`.
- **goose:** Plugs directly into `goose` over MCP so `goose`, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and other coding agents read and write the same repo memory store.
- **Agent2Agent (A2A), Agent Router, and agentgateway:** Provides a persistent, provenance-tracked shared memory layer (`hippo serve` and `MEMORY_ENVELOPE.md`) that complements agent-to-agent transport and gateway control planes.
- **AAIF Working Groups:** Aligns closely with `wg-accuracy-and-reliability` (pre-registered outcome benchmarks), `wg-security-and-privacy` (local-by-default storage, append-only auditability, and memory-contagion defenses), and `wg-workflows-and-process-integration` (cross-agent developer workflows).

### Example Use Cases and Evidence of Adoption

**Real-world use cases:**
1. **Cross-agent developer memory:** Developers run `hippo init` once in a repository to share learned rules, error fixes, and project context across Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, Pi, OpenClaw, Kiro, and any MCP client.
2. **PR-reviewed team memory and self-hosted server:** Teams commit `.hippo/` markdown mirrors to review new agent rules in pull requests, or deploy `hippo serve` for a shared team store with per-user API keys, roles, and audit logs.
3. **Reproducible agent memory benchmarking:** Researchers and teams run pre-registered outcome and public-memory benchmarks using the repository's evaluation harnesses (`docs/evals/`, `benchmarks/`).

**Evidence of adoption (as of 22 November 2026):**
- **GitHub:** 794 stars, 46 forks, 223 published releases (`https://github.com/kitfunso/hippo-memory`).
- **npm (`hippo-memory`):** 11,236 downloads in the last 30 days (23 Oct to 21 Nov 2026) and 57,404 total downloads (`https://www.npmjs.com/package/hippo-memory`).
- **Ecosystem distribution:** Published on the Official MCP Registry (`io.github.kitfunso/hippo-memory`), PyPI (`hippo-memory-sdk`), VS Code Marketplace (`kitfunso.hippo-memory`), Open VSX (`kitfunso/hippo-memory`), Cursor Directory (`https://cursor.directory/plugins/hippo-memory`), LobeHub MCP (`https://lobehub.com/mcp/kitfunso-hippo-memory`), Glama (`https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/kitfunso/hippo-memory`), Gemini CLI extension, Kiro power, OpenClaw and OpenCode plugins, and `TensorBlock/awesome-mcp-servers`.
- **Independent benchmark submission:** Official Docker evaluation wrapper submitted to PrecisionMemBench (`https://github.com/tenurehq/precisionMemBench/pull/20`).
- **Measured developer outcome:** 11 repeat mistakes per 100 chances with hippo vs 21 with built-in memory and 83 with no memory across 29 real repositories at 1.006x cost (`https://github.com/kitfunso/hippo-memory/blob/master/docs/evals/2026-11-08-z0-round3-result.md`).

### Governance Model

hippo-memory currently operates under a maintainer-led governance model with open GitHub issue tracking, pull request review, DCO sign-off (`git commit -s`, no CLA; MIT in equals MIT out), and an explicit open-core boundary documented in `CONTRIBUTING.md`.

Upon admission to AAIF Sandbox, the project will adopt Linux Foundation Minimum Viable Governance and the AAIF technical charter, adding `GOVERNANCE.md` and `OWNERS.md` with transparent committer-nomination and decision-making rules.

### CI/CD & Release Workflow

**Continuous Integration (`.github/workflows/ci.yml`):**
Runs on every pull request and push across Linux, macOS, and Windows (3 parallel shards per OS) plus a dedicated Node.js 22.16.0 minimum-engine job:
- TypeScript build (`tsc`) and public declaration diff checks (`check:dts`)
- Architectural boundary and cycle checks (`dependency-cruiser`)
- Linting and formatting (`oxlint`, `oxfmt`)
- Vitest unit, integration, and process test suites
- Real local embeddings and cross-encoder model integration tests plus micro-eval
- Dashboard UI build and test suite (`ui/`)
- Python SDK test suite against a live `hippo serve` instance (`python/`)
- Dependency security audit (`npm run audit:security`)

**Continuous Delivery & Release Cadence:**
223 semantic-versioned releases shipped since March 2026 (latest `v3.15.1`), typically multiple releases per week, managed via `changelog.d/` fragments and automated GitHub Actions workflows:
- `npm-publish.yml`: Runs `prepublishOnly` verification (migrations, manifest version sync, full build, pack smoke test, OpenClaw install smoke test, tests) and publishes `hippo-memory` to npm with provenance.
- `mcp-registry.yml`: Publishes versioned `server.json` updates to the Official MCP Registry.
- `pypi-publish.yml`: Publishes `hippo-memory-sdk` to PyPI.
- `vscode-publish.yml`: Publishes the VS Code extension via OIDC Trusted Publishing and Open VSX.
- `sbom.yml`: Generates and attaches a CycloneDX SBOM (`scripts/sbom.mjs`) to every GitHub release.
- `website.yml`: Builds, checks, and deploys `https://hippo-memory.com`.

### Public-Facing Contribution Process for Specifications

All code and specification changes follow the public pull-request and DCO sign-off process in `https://github.com/kitfunso/hippo-memory/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md`.

Core data, architecture, and integration specifications live in-repo as versioned documents updated through pull requests and architectural decision records (`docs/decisions/`):
- Memory provenance envelope specification: `https://github.com/kitfunso/hippo-memory/blob/master/MEMORY_ENVELOPE.md`
- Architecture and design principles: `https://github.com/kitfunso/hippo-memory/blob/master/PLAN.md`
- Execution roadmap and track specifications: `https://github.com/kitfunso/hippo-memory/blob/master/ROADMAP.md`
- Agent installation protocol: `https://github.com/kitfunso/hippo-memory/blob/master/llms-install.md`

### External Project Dependencies

**Core runtime (`hippo-memory` on npm):**
- Zero required runtime dependencies. Runs directly on Node.js >= 22.16.0 using built-in `node:sqlite` (with FTS5).

**Optional local embeddings (installed by `hippo init`, skippable via `--no-embeddings`):**
- `@huggingface/transformers` (Apache-2.0) / `@xenova/transformers` (Apache-2.0)

**Root build, lint, and test devDependencies:**
- `typescript` (Apache-2.0)
- `vitest`, `@vitest/coverage-v8`, `vite` (MIT)
- `oxlint`, `@oxlint/plugins`, `oxfmt` (MIT)
- `dependency-cruiser` (MIT)
- `@types/node` (MIT)

**Local dashboard UI (`ui/`, bundled in `dist-ui`):**
- `react`, `react-dom` (MIT)
- `@fontsource/ibm-plex-sans`, `@fontsource/ibm-plex-mono` (OFL-1.1)

**Python SDK (`python/`, `hippo-memory-sdk` on PyPI):**
- `httpx` (BSD-3-Clause)
- `pydantic` (MIT)

All runtime, optional, UI, SDK, and build dependencies use OSI-approved permissive or open font licenses. No GPL, LGPL, or AGPL dependencies are used.

### Lifecycle Stage Evidence

**Sandbox Stage Written Thesis:**

1. **Intended users:**
   - Individual developers working across multiple AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, goose, OpenCode, Gemini CLI, Kiro, Pi, OpenClaw, and any MCP client) who want one local, inspectable memory store.
   - Software engineering teams wanting git-committable, PR-reviewable agent rules and a self-hosted shared team memory server (`hippo serve`) with API keys, roles, and audit logging.
   - Agent framework and harness developers looking for a zero-LLM-call, provenance-tracked reference memory layer and schema (`MEMORY_ENVELOPE.md`).

2. **Why hippo-memory matters and documented early external interest:**
   - Coding agents today lose user corrections between sessions or lock memory inside a single vendor's cloud with an extra LLM call per write. hippo-memory makes agent memory local, portable, fast, and verifiable across every harness, cutting repeat mistakes from 21 in 100 to 11 in 100 across 29 real repositories at the same token cost (1.006x).
   - Documented external interest as of 22 November 2026: 794 GitHub stars, 46 forks, 11,236 npm downloads in the last 30 days (57,404 total), 223 releases, and active distribution across the Official MCP Registry, VS Code Marketplace, PyPI, Cursor Directory, LobeHub, and Glama.

3. **What will justify Growth graduation (6 to 12 month roadmap):**
   - Documented production adoption by at least two unaffiliated organizations (engineering-team pilot outreach is underway).
   - Active committers and merged contributions from at least two independent organizations under published `GOVERNANCE.md` and `OWNERS.md` policies.
   - Cross-project alignment of `MEMORY_ENVELOPE.md` and MCP memory conventions with AAIF projects (MCP, `AGENTS.md`, `goose`) and working groups (`wg-accuracy-and-reliability`, `wg-security-and-privacy`).
   - Expanded open, pre-registered outcome benchmarks and independent leaderboard evaluations (including PrecisionMemBench).

**Public roadmap:** https://github.com/kitfunso/hippo-memory/blob/master/ROADMAP.md

### Security

- **Vulnerability reporting:** Private vulnerability reporting via GitHub Security Advisories, documented in `https://github.com/kitfunso/hippo-memory/blob/master/SECURITY.md` (3-working-day acknowledgement, 10-day assessment target).
- **Automated security scanning (`.github/workflows/security-scan.yml`):**
  - GitHub CodeQL (`security-extended` queries for JavaScript/TypeScript) on PRs, master pushes, and weekly schedule.
  - Gitleaks (`v8.30.1`, pinned by SHA-256) secret scanning on PRs, pushes, and weekly schedule.
  - Dependency security audit (`npm run audit:security`) on every PR and weekly schedule.
- **Supply-chain provenance:** CycloneDX SBOM attached to every GitHub release (`.github/workflows/sbom.yml`), npm provenance attestations on publish, and OIDC Trusted Publishing for VS Code Marketplace.
- **Local-by-default security posture:** Memories live locally in SQLite and markdown with zero required network calls on recall; optional custom LLM endpoints enforce HTTPS with explicit opt-in controls.
- OpenSSF Best Practices badge registration is planned during Sandbox onboarding.
